selector.why: the presence of tender, warm, erythematous nodular skin lesions and histopathological findings of severe diffuse lympho-monocytic inflammation with minimal necrosis, angioinvasive microbial structures, and sparse hyphal mats with sporangial-type cells, along with thin-walled pauciseptate hyphae and thick-walled ovoid sporangia, specifically support Blastomycosis.
